name: Woods House - Quakertown
notes: Historic Quakertown house owned by William Evelyn Woods. Denton County states that it originally stood approximately a block and a half from the College of Industrial Arts and across from the original Fred Douglass School.

name: Woods Family Property - Solomon Hill
notes: Denton County records state that the Woods family purchased 8.8 acres on Solomon Hill after selling their Quakertown property during the 1921 displacement.

name: Frederick Douglass Colored School
notes: Historically Black school in Denton. The Moore family oral history discusses Fred Moore's appointment as principal in 1915.
